data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root letters 'Aql' which means intelligence, wisdom and 'Lam' which means abundance and wealth. The name Iqleemah means 'Bountiful, Rich'. The name Iqleemah carries the meaning “Bountiful, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Iqleemah usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iqleemah is a name that signifies abundance and richness in spiritual terms. It is a name that is given to a child who is believed to have the potential to become a source of wisdom, intelligence and wealth for others.
data.etymology: Iqleemah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bountiful, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqleemah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Furthermore, Iqleemah, as a person of intelligence, can use their knowledge to help and benefit others, earning them blessings in this world and the hereafter.
